content: Ampicillin Trihydrate Capsules, USP, are intended for oral administration. Each capsule contains ampicillin trihydrate in an amount equivalent to either 250 mg or 500 mg of ampicillin. The capsules are supplied as follows: 250 mg capsules: These are white, opaque, hard gelatin capsules imprinted with GG 850/GG 850 in black ink. They are available in: Bottles of 100 capsules (NDC 0781-2144-01) Bottles of 500 capsules (NDC 0781-2144-05) 500 mg capsules: These are white, opaque, hard gelatin capsules imprinted with GG 851/GG 851 in black ink. They are available in: Bottles of 100 capsules (NDC 0781-2145-01) Bottles of 500 capsules (NDC 0781-2145-05) The product should be stored at a controlled room temperature of 20°C to 25°C (68°F to 77°F), as defined by USP Controlled Room Temperature guidelines. It must be dispensed in a tightly sealed container to ensure product integrity.
